lesson.prerequisite_note: Read the existing IPv4, ordinary permissions, numeric membership and saved/live mount lessons before this separate example.

concepts.title: Separate saved and current layers
concepts.text: Save keeps the edited document, Apply changes the export table, and Mount creates a separate current mount. No host service is contacted.

concepts.title: Identity and path search
concepts.text: Use supplied numeric profiles. A directory needs search permission and an existing file needs its own access bits. Inode metadata is immutable here: chmod, chown and creating files are not available. Select an eligible supplied identity or repair a supported export/mount layer; diagnose unsupported metadata changes honestly.

concepts.title: Exports and saved mount grammar
concepts.text: An export row is /supplied/root IPv4-or-CIDR(options), with adjacent parentheses. Defaults are ro and root_squash; explicit rw permits writes only when client mode and numeric permissions also allow them. A saved client row has IPv4:/supplied/root /declared/target nfs vers=3,proto=tcp,sec=sys,ro-or-rw 0 0. Save does not apply exports or mount the saved row.

concepts.title: Root squashing maps numeric identities
concepts.text: root_squash independently maps UID zero and each zero group ID to anonymous numbers, normally65534; nonzero supplementary groups survive. Anonymous-owned files can therefore be accessible: squashing is not deny-all-root. Unsquashed UID0 capability paths are unsupported; a preceding declared client or export read-only write gate is still a defined mode denial.

concepts.title: Check actual current and future outcomes
concepts.text: A permission decision does not publish file bytes. Use explicit Write when required. New-mount tests use private scratch mounts; errors and unsupported requests never count as access denials.

lesson.example_description: Mount /srv/gallery0/reference read-only for c-gallery0-old at /mnt/gallery0/reference, read its supplied notice, commit matching saved/applied exports and the saved client row, and deny a new outsider mount. Preserve c-gallery0-archive's archive mount and archive notice exactly.
